packageRules.description: mise.toml copies of caddy, node and uv follow the Dockerfile, and pnpm follows web/package.json, via bin/renovate-postupgrade. bin/lint fails if they drift.
The image's Python is Alpine's python3~3.14, so a Python minor or major is a manual change with the Alpine tag.
Node majors are a manual change: the Dockerfile, mise.toml and engines move together.
Node's lower bound moves with the manual Node major change.
Java majors are a manual change: the Temurin tags and javac --release move together, from one LTS to the next.
The uv_build range follows the Dockerfile's uv via bin/renovate-postupgrade.
Renovate's docker datasource has release timestamps only on Docker Hub, so without this the 14-day wait would hold this GHCR image forever.
Monthly uv.lock and pnpm-lock.yaml refresh, so transitive pins such as tzdata move too.
prBodyNotes: **Deploy**: auto — Railway rebuilds the image on merge to `main`.

packageRules.description: Major version bumps always land in their own PR regardless of grouping. Major bumps break things; review one at a time.
The validator's jars stay in one PR even for majors, after the rule above, so slf4j-api and slf4j-nop move together.
prBodyNotes: **Deploy**: auto — Railway rebuilds the image on merge to `main`. `bin/test-feeds` runs the new jars in CI.
